_note: Candidate sub-categories as proposed by the discovery stage (US 311617 stage 3), illustrative. proposed_parent is what discovery suggested; expected_parent is the SME answer, used only to score the trial. C8 has too little support on purpose; C9 was proposed under the wrong parent on purpose. expected_reports is the hand-labelled answer key used only to score the trial (precision and recall of report links).

candidates.name: Landing or takeoff on an unintended surface
candidates.definition: The aircraft lands, lines up to land, or starts a takeoff on a surface other than the assigned runway: a taxiway, a closed or wrong runway, or the wrong airport.

candidates.name: Runway entry or crossing without clearance
candidates.definition: An aircraft or vehicle crosses a hold-short line, stop bar or holding point and enters an active runway without a clearance.

candidates.name: Overrun after a long or fast landing on a wet or contaminated runway
candidates.definition: The aircraft touches down long or fast on a wet or contaminated runway, braking is poor, and it overruns the runway end.

candidates.name: Upset or stall after unreliable airspeed
candidates.definition: Disagreeing or erroneous airspeed indications, for example from icing or pitot failure, lead to a stall warning, overspeed or upset in flight.

candidates.name: TCAS resolution advisory after an altitude deviation
candidates.definition: The aircraft deviates from its cleared altitude (level bust) and traffic receives a TCAS resolution advisory or separation is lost.

candidates.name: Clear-air turbulence with cabin injuries
candidates.definition: An unexpected encounter with turbulence in clear air injures passengers or cabin crew who are standing, unbelted or near unsecured carts.

candidates.name: Engine damage or shutdown after bird ingestion
candidates.definition: Birds ingested into an engine cause vibration, surge, loss of thrust, fire warning or shutdown.

candidates.name: Takeoff after de-icing holdover time exceeded
candidates.definition: The aircraft is delayed after ground de-icing and the fluid holdover time is exceeded before takeoff.

candidates.name: Hard landing or tail strike
candidates.definition: A hard or bounced touchdown, or contact of the tail with the runway during rotation or flare.
